patterns: APPSC asks sect/symbol matches (Jainism-Triratna, Buddhism-Ashtanga Marga, Saivism-Linga, Animism-Nature worship) and Saiva-sect origins (Kapalikas from Misra Saivam).
AP-specific facts recur: Gudimallam = oldest Shiva linga, Salankayanas = Vaishnavism, number of Mahapuranas = 18.
Other PSCs: earliest epigraphic evidence of Bhagavatism = Besnagar Garuda pillar; Bhagavatas first worshipped Vasudeva-Krishna; Panchayatana = temple style; Deogarh = Gupta art.
Traps: Kapalika keys differ across APPSC papers (Pashupata vs Misra Saivam); first 'Parama Bhagavata' contested; read options carefully.
App adds temple-stage details and Buddhist scholar matches; these are sound but deeper than APPSC's single-fact style.
